text:
Adhesive wound closure strips that are stitched into the skin should be removed by a healthcare professional, not by the patient, to avoid disrupting wound healing or causing injury. If removal is advised, follow the clinician’s specific instructions, which may include softening the adhesive and gently cutting or peeling the strips under sterile conditions. Do not attempt self-removal of stitched-in strips without medical guidance.
